name: Rashizun IDE (The Rightly Guided)

adaptations.details: Renamed from Rashidun to Rashizun to align with 'The Rightly Guided' theme.
Integrated 7-Stage SDLC Lifecycle strategy from Gemini conversation (2026-05-05).

adaptation_deltas: Standardized all service ports to 72xx prefix and enabled multi-arch Docker builds.

architectural_decisions.decision: Use Dockerfile.build for reproducible 2026-standard build environments.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Ensures environment parity and isolates build dependencies from the host.

architectural_decisions.decision: Standardize all service ports to 72xx prefix.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Avoids conflicts with common ports and provides a unified Rashizun namespace.

architectural_decisions.decision: Transition to platform-agnostic, multi-arch Docker builds via TARGETARCH.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Enables native builds on arm64/amd64/riscv64 without complex cross-compilation toolchains.
